faultline.blocked.excluded_tool: Faultline can't be used with this item
faultline.blocked.tool_required: Hold a tool to use Faultline
faultline.configuration.title: Faultline Settings
faultline.configuration.maxBlocks.toolti: Most blocks one vein-mine can break, counting the block you broke yourself.
faultline.configuration.maxDistance.tool: How far from the first block, in blocks, the selection can reach.
faultline.configuration.hungerPerBlock.t: Extra exhaustion for each additional block broken. Vanilla already adds 0.005 per block.
faultline.configuration.cooldownTicks.to: Ticks to wait between vein-mines. 20 ticks is one second.
faultline.configuration.stopBeforeToolBr: Stop mining when the tool has one point of durability left, so it never breaks.
faultline.configuration.gatherDrops.tool: Drop everything at the block you broke instead of across the vein.
faultline.configuration.dropsToInventory: With Gather Drops on, put drops straight into your inventory. Anything that doesn't fit drops at the block.
faultline.configuration.mergeOreVariants: Treat stone and deepslate versions of the same ore as the same block.
faultline.configuration.mergeWood.toolti: Treat logs and wood from the same kind of tree as the same block.
faultline.configuration.shapedModesMatch: Tunnel and square modes only take blocks that match the one you broke.
faultline.configuration.requireTool.tool: Only vein-mine while holding a tool. When off, any item or a bare hand works.
faultline.configuration.modes.tooltip: Choose which modes players can scroll to.
Every matching block connected to the one you broke.
faultline.configuration.modes.small_tunn: A 1x1 line into the face you hit.
faultline.configuration.modes.mining_tun: A 1 wide, 2 tall tunnel into the face you hit.
faultline.configuration.modes.large_tunn: A 3x3 tunnel into the face you hit.
faultline.configuration.modes.escape_tun: A 1 wide, 2 tall staircase going up and away from you.
faultline.configuration.modes.small_squa: A flat 3x3 square on the face you hit.
faultline.configuration.hudEnabled.toolt: Show the Faultline panel while the key is held.
faultline.configuration.hudCorner.toolti: Which corner of the screen the panel sits in.
faultline.configuration.hudOffsetX.toolt: Pixels between the panel and the left or right edge of the screen, on whichever side its corner is.
faultline.configuration.hudOffsetY.toolt: Pixels between the panel and the top or bottom edge of the screen. Raise it to clear other overlays such as an FPS counter.
faultline.configuration.outlineColor.too: Colour of the selection outline as RRGGBB hex, for example FFFFFF for white.
faultline.configuration.rememberLastMode: Start in the mode you used last instead of Shapeless.
faultline.configuration.invertScroll.too: Reverse which way the mouse wheel cycles through the modes.
faultline.configuration.lastMode.tooltip: The mode you used last. The game fills this in; used when Remember Last Mode is on.
